config.name: g1_reach_heights_v2
config._note: W6 protocol v2. Written before any v2 run. STATUS: DRAFT, NOT FROZEN: the code is frozen (SHA recorded in the held-out meta.json) only after the development evidence is reviewed. v1 stays scored under v1 (results/g1_reach_heights_heldout, config g1_reach_heights.json). The v1 held-out seeds 5000-5023 have been seen and are now DEVELOPMENT evidence; the v2 held-out seeds 6000-6023 are fresh and must be run exactly once after the freeze. Backend 'wbc' (NVIDIA Decoupled WBC); 'sonic' is added later.
config.success_definition: evaluator: hand-geom/handle-geom contact sustained >= 0.3 s (unbroken), no collapse (C3 criteria), no unresolved protective stop, peak hand-handle force <= 25 N

heldout.handle_colour: drawn per seed from the detector palette (red orange yellow green blue purple)
heldout.fixture_size: depth half 0.15-0.30, width half 0.25-0.50, height from max(0.55, h+0.12) up to +0.5 m (dream/sim/reach_scenes.py)

gates._note: Pre-registered for the new system (agent). The baseline is reported on identical scenes against the same numbers for reference.

config.disjoint: v2 held-out seeds 6000-6023 share no seed with dev 100-105 or v1 held-out 5000-5023 (now development).

planner._note: Stance sampling of the agent's posture planner (dream.robot.g1_posture.PlannerConfig). Changed during development from the W3 default radii (0.45, 0.6, 0.75) after dev run 1: a 0.45 m stance leaves the arm nearly straight at the contact point (no room for a pre-contact pose, torque stops).

changes_from_v1.success: v1: true distance reach-point-to-handle-CENTRE <= 0.03 m. v2: the evaluator detects hand-geom / handle-geom contact sustained >= 0.3 s with no collapse, no unresolved protective stop and peak hand-handle contact force <= 25 N (the top of the Dex3-1 tactile range). Reason: the fingertip contact floor is 13-25 mm from the centre, and a probe 30 mm away can touch nothing.
changes_from_v1.agent_claim: v1: FK distance to the perceived target <= tolerance - 1.645 sigma. v2: the hand's own simulated touch sensors report contact >= 0.3 s AND forward kinematics puts the reach point within 3 Mahalanobis units of the perceived handle (covariance widened by the 5 cm handle half-width).
changes_from_v1.reference: v1: one label, the planner+open-loop rollout under dense truth inputs. v2: TWO labels, both reported: (i) dense truth-input capability search with the closed-loop rollout (pre-contact, corrections, advance), k = 12 ranked plans; (ii) the agent's own procedure fed truth inputs (system agent_truth_inputs).
changes_from_v1.gate_values: unchanged from v1 (max_collapses 0, max_false_success_claims 0, success_feasible_min 0.8, success_feasible_off_band_min 0.7, correct_refusal_min 0.9); they are applied with the new success definition and, for 'feasible', with reference label (i) (label (ii) reported beside it).
changes_from_v1.seeds: held-out 6000-6023, same distributions as v1. Development = v1 dev (36) + v1 held-out (24, seeds 5000-5023).
changes_from_v1.agent_code: closed-loop rollout gate, torque-aware correction, measured-torque ranking, canonical planning boxes, shoulder-torso limit, axis relaxation, anisotropic dev-fitted target covariance, unseen box tops (W6 commits).

success.definition: evaluator: hand-geom/handle-geom contact sustained >= 0.3 s (unbroken), no collapse (C3 criteria), no unresolved protective stop, peak hand-handle force <= 25 N

config.touch_sensor_note: Dex3-1 carries 33 tactile sensors per hand over palm, finger pads and fingertips (Unitree, https://unitree.com/Dex3-1; retailer listings give ~10 g - 2.5 kg at 1 kHz). Simulated by one MuJoCo touch sensor per hand link (sites only, dream/sim/g1_mobile.py _add_touch_sensors), threshold 0.1 N. Idealised stand-in; not a model of the real sensor.

instruction_parsing: structured goal parsing, not language understanding
